setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Something went wrong/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast][data-type=error]').forEach(t=>{const s='TOAST DE ERRO: '+t.textContent.trim().slice(0,90);if(!window.__avisos.includes(s)&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(s)})},300);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["2 caixas encontrados"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main")];const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,240);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}return [...document.querySelectorAll('main')].find(e=>/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(e).overflowY)&&e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+4)||null};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll("main *")].filter(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim().startsWith("Transa\u00e7\u00f5es do Dia"))[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const y0=c.scrollTop;const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-140);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1100),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0+dy*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
